stories.title: Six Gujarat startups raise Rs 287 crore
stories.summary: Six Gujarat-based startups raised Rs 287 crore over four months. The funding spans sectors from hydrogen-powered drones to artificial intelligence. Cellegant Energy Systems, founded by an IIT Gandhinagar professor, secured Rs 2.6 crore to develop hybrid hydrogen fuel-cell electric drivetrain systems for drones. The drones are expected to last longer.

stories.title: Indian startup funding hits $255 million
stories.summary: Twenty Indian startups raised $255 million in the first week of November, a 96 percent increase from the previous week. Deal count fell 38 percent to 20. GIVA led with $103 million, while EloElo Group secured $80 million. Capital is moving, even if the number of deals is not.

stories.title: Asian startups record $573.5 million in funding
stories.summary: Asian startups raised $573.5 million this week, with China leading through a $200 million round for AI video startup aSand.ai and $137.5 million for chipmaker Moffett AI. India and Japan saw activity across robotics, healthcare and clean energy. AI remains the preferred destination for large checks.

stories.title: Cosmoserve Space raises $6 million for debris removal
stories.summary: Hyderabad-based Cosmoserve Space raised $6 million in a seed round led by Japan's Rebright Partners. The company is building robotic spacecraft to capture dead satellites and pull them out of orbit. It has also opened a facility in Hyderabad. The goal is to clean up space.

stories.title: Two Point O Capital raises $10 million
stories.summary: Two Point O Capital, an AI-powered clean energy deployment platform, raised $10 million led by Transition Venture Capital. The firm intends to use the capital to coordinate work across systems and clean energy projects. The funding follows a week of activity in deeptech and healthtech sectors.

stories.title: Venomics AI secures $2.7 million
stories.summary: Venomics AI has raised $2.7 million in a pre-seed funding round. The company operates in the artificial intelligence sector. Further details regarding the company's specific product roadmap or commercial strategy were not disclosed in the announcement.

stories.title: OneStack raises Rs 12.5 crore
stories.summary: Fintech startup OneStack raised Rs 12.5 crore from Shepherd's Hill and existing backers. The company builds banking and payments technology for cooperative banks. It has now raised over Rs 45 crore across four rounds. The capital is earmarked for expansion and regulatory compliance.

stories.title: altM raises $10.3 million for bio-based chemicals
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM raised $10.3 million in a Series A round led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company plans to scale its manufacturing of bio-based industrial chemicals. It is transitioning from research and development to commercial production. Chemicals are now being asked to be organic.

stories.title: Cosmoserve Space opens debris removal facility
stories.summary: Cosmoserve Space raised $6 million in a seed round led by Rebright Partners, bringing its total funding to over $9 million. The company inaugurated Base 1 in Hyderabad, which it describes as India's first space debris removal facility. It plans to use the funds for upcoming missions.

stories.title: Blitz raises 28.7 crore rupees
stories.summary: Logistics and commerce startup Blitz has raised 28.7 crore rupees in a pre-Series B funding round. The company provides shipping and fulfillment services for brands. The capital is intended to support the company's ongoing operations and infrastructure development.

stories.title: Fal reaches $16 billion valuation
stories.summary: AI inference startup Fal has raised capital at a $16 billion valuation. Meanwhile, Crowdstrike has announced two new deals. The full details of these transactions are available to subscribers of the source publication.

stories.title: Pliant and Kalepa secure new funding
stories.summary: Pliant has raised $80 million, while Global Payments is being taken private in a $40 billion deal. Additionally, Kalepa has reached a $470 million valuation. The full details of these market movements are available to subscribers of the source publication.

stories.title: Shield AI leads $2 billion funding round
stories.summary: Defense tech startup Shield AI secured $2 billion, the largest financing round of the week. Drone delivery provider Zipline International followed with $1.5 billion. The week was defined by large rounds for companies focused on autonomy and simulation. The scale of the capital remains significant.

stories.title: Journify raises $12 million
stories.summary: San Francisco-based advertising technology company Journify raised $12 million in a Series A round led by Al Mada Ventures. The company claims its revenue has grown more than fivefold. It helps businesses share purchase data with platforms like Google and Meta. Growth is currently the primary metric.

stories.title: Giva secures over $100 million
stories.summary: Ecommerce brand Giva has raised over $100 million in new funding. The company operates in the direct-to-consumer retail space. The full details regarding the investors and the company's valuation are available to subscribers of the source publication.

stories.title: Fal raises $1.3 billion
stories.summary: AI inference startup Fal raised $1.3 billion in a Series F round, reaching a $16 billion valuation. Nooks secured a $500 million financing commitment from General Catalyst. Other deals included Titan OS and Archera. AI continues to attract the largest share of global startup capital.

stories.title: Nature Select raises $100 million
stories.summary: Shenzhen-based AI social startup Nature Select raised over $100 million in a Series A+ round. Investors include 5Y Capital and Qiming Venture Partners. The company develops 3D AI companions and social products. It aims to foster long-term relationships between people and artificial intelligence.

stories.title: URobotics raises $29.9 million
stories.summary: Robot autonomy startup URobotics raised $29.9 million in a Series A round. The company reports a tenfold jump in its valuation. The full details regarding the company's technology and future expansion plans are available to subscribers of the source publication.

stories.title: AI coworker startup raises $115 million
stories.summary: Australian-founded Future Secure AI has raised US$80 million (A$115m) to expand its customer base globally. The firm will use Ondine Capital Fund III

stories.summary: October was a busy month for U.S. startup funding, led by well-known venture investors with a healthy appetite for big deals. stories.title: Mamaearth Parent Honasa’s Q2 Profit Jumps 87% YoY To ₹73 Cr
stories.summary: Mamaearth parent Honasa Consumer reported an 86.7% increase in its consolidated net profit to ₹73.2 Cr in the September quarter (Q2 FY27) from ₹39.2 Cr in the year-ago period. The beauty and personal care (BPC) company’s operating revenue rose 35.9% to ₹731.2 Cr from ₹538.1

stories.title: Sai Life Sciences shares rise after results
stories.summary: Sai Life Sciences shares rose 8.86 percent after the company reported a 17 percent increase in net profit for the September quarter. Revenue from operations grew 23 percent to 659 crore rupees. The stock reached a new 52-week high during the session.

stories.title: Go Digit profit falls 31 percent
stories.summary: Insurtech Go Digit reported a 31.1 percent year-on-year decline in net profit to ₹142.4 Cr for the September quarter. Profit fell 62.4 percent sequentially from the June quarter. Insurance revenue rose 1.7 percent, but the company's bottom line did not follow the same trajectory.

stories.title: Amagi revenue grows 27 percent
stories.summary: Amagi Media Labs reported a 27 percent year-on-year increase in revenue to Rs 476 crore for the September quarter. Profit after tax rose nearly 30-fold to Rs 75 crore from Rs 2.5 crore in the year-ago period. Growth was attributed to cloud, streaming, and advertising businesses.

stories.title: Bhoomi exhibition opens in Bengaluru
stories.summary: The Bhoomi exhibition at Venkatappa Art Gallery explores the balance between individual expression and collective vision. The showcase is part of a long-running series featuring various creative works in Bengaluru. The gallery continues to host group exhibitions focused on themes of art and local culture.

stories.title: Deepinder Goyal defends Temple wearable
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal is facing scrutiny over his ₹85,000 wearable device, Temple. The gadget claims to track brain activity and blood flow, though doctors have questioned its scientific basis. Goyal maintains it is a wellness product and not a medical device. Pre-orders are currently open.

stories.title: Udaipur startup gifts back massagers
stories.summary: A startup in Udaipur reportedly gifted employees back massagers valued at Rs 13,000 for Diwali. The move drew attention on social media, where users compared the gift to the company's internal culture. The full details of the incident are currently unavailable due to server restrictions.

stories.title: Canva restructures 22 percent of workforce
stories.summary: Canva is cutting 1,271 jobs, representing 22 percent of its staff. CEO Melanie Perkins shared the news in a note that has been praised by industry peers for its severance package. The announcement is being cited as a case study in how to handle corporate layoffs.

stories.title: Nikesh Arora warns on AI vulnerabilities
stories.summary: Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora says AI is helping attackers find software vulnerabilities faster than enterprises can fix them. He is calling for more collaborative vulnerability management. The speed of AI-driven exploitation is currently outpacing the capacity of many internal security teams to respond.

stories.title: Engineering leaders discuss AI automation
stories.summary: Leaders from various sectors met to discuss balancing AI-driven speed with system reliability. The roundtable focused on the challenge of maintaining control as code generation becomes cheaper. The consensus was that while AI makes writing code faster, the difficulty lies in managing what happens afterward.

stories.title: Operational excellence in startup growth
stories.summary: Startups often focus on funding and sales while neglecting the operational foundations required for long-term sustainability. The article argues that reliable data and governance are necessary to survive the period following a growth spike. A good quarter is not the same as a built company.

stories.title: Deepinder Goyal addresses Temple criticism
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal defended his Temple wearable against claims of scientific invalidity, noting he invested $20 million of his own money into the project. He argued that a scam would typically aim for profit, whereas this venture is currently recovering only a small fraction of its $30 million cost.

stories.title: Companies set policies against AI-generated work
stories.summary: Tech recruiting firm Twill has implemented policies against AI-generated internal communications after employees began sending messages copied from Claude. CEO Michelle Volberg noted that the AI-written pings sounded annoyingly optimistic and robotic. Some workers have faced termination for relying on bots to handle their daily tasks.
